content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text makes the open sense of the single verse Isaiah 7:14 a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the conduct K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.","room":"The phrase 'It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains' was read either as exempting this because 'D5 vs C5' weighs two chains, or as not exempting it because the judge is deciding the open sense of the one verse Isaiah 7:14.","why":"The judge marks Isaiah 7:14 UNDERDETERMINED because its sign's sense is left open, contrary to K-S2's statement that a verse carrying two senses at once is not open and both senses stand."}
